items.title: US Spot Bitcoin ETF Daily Net Flows ($ millions)
items.description: Daily net flows into and out of US spot bitcoin ETFs in $ millions (Farside data), green for inflow days and red for outflow days, since late July 2026.
items.reason: Bitcoin fell to about $55K overnight, its lowest since September 2024, after US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.25B from Tuesday through Friday, including $582M on Thursday.

items.title: Strategy's preferred stock, Feb 2025–Oct 2026: $15.5B peak, $13.9B after STRC buybacks
items.description: Strategy's preferred stock outstanding by series (STRF, STRC, STRE, STRK, STRD) at stated amount, weekly since February 2025: a $15.5B peak, with STRC shrinking from $10.5B as Strategy buys it back.
items.reason: At Thursday's investor Q&A, Strategy said it has bought back about $3B of STRC at $95 to $99, and Saylor put natural demand at $5B to $7.5B, with STRC closing Friday at $93.60, below its $100 par.

items.title: Tesla's active FSD subscriptions: 1.74M, up 67% in a year (Q3 2026)
items.description: Tesla's active FSD subscriptions (upfront purchases plus monthly subscriptions, excluding free trials) by quarter from Tesla's updates: 0.95M in Q2 2025 to 1.74M in Q3 2026.
items.reason: Musk said this morning that FSD V15 goes to wide release in December with the holiday update.

items.title: Hyperscaler free cash flow (incl. SpaceX)
items.description: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and SpaceX free cash flow, 2014–2030E. Combined FCF is estimated to trough around –$408bn in 2027 (SpaceX, incl. xAI & X, –$315bn) before rebounding in 2030. Actuals from SEC 10-Ks; estimates from S&P Global consensus, company capex guidance and Steve's DCF (updated Nov 20, 2026).
items.reason: SpaceX priced about $44B of GPU financing led by Apollo and Goldman, including $32B of bonds whose largest tranche yields 8.259%, as AI stocks sold off.

items.title: VIX vs S&P 500 (10Y)
items.description: The VIX (right axis) against the S&P 500 (left axis) over the past 10 years. Volatility spikes line up with equity drawdowns, including 2020, 2022 and April 2025.
items.reason: The VIX jumped about 37% on Friday to 38.83, its highest close since April 2025, as the S&P 500 and Dow closed in correction.
